declarations.name: AuiCard

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Card heading and the <article>'s accessible name (aria-labelledby). Without a title the card is a <div>.

inputs.name: subtitle
inputs.description: Supporting line under the title (text only).

inputs.name: content
inputs.description: Body content; strings render as text. Omit to fill card.body directly.

inputs.name: footer
inputs.description: Footer content such as actions or metadata.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: Image or illustration, shown above the header while the header stays first in source order.

inputs.name: interactive
inputs.description: Block-link mode: the title becomes the only link and its ::after covers the card. Requires title; href must be http(s) or relative.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading level of the card title; match it to the surrounding outline.

accessibility.pattern: HTML <article> named by its heading; interactive cards use the block-link pattern (Inclusive Components 'Cards'): one real link on the title, stretched over the card with a pseudo-element.

limitations: In interactive cards, the link overlay makes body text hard to select with the mouse (a known trade-off of the block-link pattern).
Other controls inside an interactive card are lifted above the overlay and remain separate tab stops.
The card root element is replaced when a title is added or removed, because the tag changes between <article> and <div>.
Surface and Card do not manage elevation stacking contexts.
